title: Handling of NAS level mobility management congestion control

entities.name: NAS level mobility management congestion control
entities.description: Network procedure to handle EMM signalling congestion through general congestion control and subscribed APN based congestion control. It involves rejecting mobility management requests and managing back-off timers.

entities.name: Subscribed APN based congestion control
entities.description: Specific congestion control activated for a particular APN where the network may reject attach requests from UEs subscribed to that APN.

entities.name: Timer T3346
entities.description: Mobility management back-off timer included in reject messages during congestion control. UE starts this timer upon receiving reject messages to defer subsequent requests.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state where the UE is not registered with the network.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE
entities.description: EMM state entered when UE attempts to update its registration after TAI change and EMM update status change.

entities.name: Low priority indicator
entities.description: Indicator in NAS request messages (e.g., ATTACH REQUEST) set to 'MS is configured for NAS signalling low priority'.

entities.name: NAS signalling congestion detection condition
entities.description: Condition where network detects NAS signalling congestion based on message rates from UEs with subscription to a particular APN or network management settings.

entities.name: PLMN change condition
entities.description: Condition where UE enters a new PLMN not equivalent to the PLMN where T3346 was started.

entities.name: TAI change condition
entities.description: Condition where UE changes TAI which is not part of TAI list, with EMM update status EU1 UPDATED.

entities.name: EMM update status EU2 NOT UPDATED
entities.description: EMM update status set to NOT UPDATED after TAI change when T3346 is running and previous status was EU1 UPDATED.

relations.description: NAS level mobility management congestion control includes subscribed APN based congestion control as a specific procedure.
Network includes T3346 value in reject messages during congestion control, causing UE to start the timer.
Subscribed APN based congestion control is activated based on congestion detection conditions like message rate thresholds.
If T3346 is running when UE enters EMM-DEREGISTERED state, the timer continues running until expiry or stop.
UE stops T3346 when initiating mobility management procedures in a new non-equivalent PLMN.
TAI change condition causes UE to set EMM update status to EU2 NOT UPDATED.
TAI change condition causes UE to enter state EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE.
T3346 behavior at switch-on is guarded by whether the low priority indicator was set in the original NAS request.
